sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Blinds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Blind and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 50

[Cool Charm] Leia or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
